articles.title: President Donald Trump Demands Investigation into Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin's Comments
articles.summary: Michigan Senator Debbie Stabenow, Preet Bharara, Elissa Slotkin
articles.content: Democratic Senator Elissa Slotkin is facing a potential investigation into her recent comments on the impact of Democratic investigations into the Trump administration. The investigation was prompted by a demand from President Donald Trump himself, who posted on his social media platform over the weekend that he wanted the Justice Department to look into Slotkin's remarks. Slotkin's attorney has issued a warning to Attorney General Todd Blanche not to comply with this request, calling it "frivolous and questioning why the White House is interfering in what should be an independent investigation. As an appointed member of the president's Cabinet, Blanche would normally be expected to maintain some level of independence from the White House. The White House has issued a demand for Michigan Senator Debbie Slotkin to be investigated over comments she made about deterring young people from joining the administration. Slotkin had spoken at the University of Chicago just before the midterm elections, warning that Democrats should focus their investigative efforts on those who enable President Trump's behavior. She expressed hope that her words would discourage young people from getting involved in the administration, which might lead to personal problems for them. The demand for an investigation was prompted by comments Slotkin made about the potential consequences of working with an administration where leaders may ask employees to break the law or misuse taxpayer funds. These remarks were deemed entirely lawful by Preet Bharara, a lawyer who pointed out that they are protected by the First Amendment and the speech and debate" clause of the Constitution. Bharara argued that there is no basis for investigating Slotkin over her comments, which simply expressed a desire to hold those in power accountable for their actions. The Justice Department has been asked by Bharara not to follow through on Trump's demand to investigate Slotkin over her comments about holding those in power accountable for their actions. Bharara urged Blanche to publicly decline the request, stating that it is a threat to constitutional freedoms and would be another frivolous investigation at taxpayers' expense. He noted that such an action would undermine the principles of free speech and accountability that are fundamental to democracy. This warning comes just over a year after the administration failed to indict Slotkin and five other members of Congress for a social media video reminding them of their duties not to follow unlawful orders. The grand jury had unanimously rejected the Department's attempt to punish Slotkin for her lawful speech, emphasizing that it was constitutionally privileged. articles.title: Ina Garten's Chive Biscuits Recipe for Thanksgiving
articles.summary: A novice baker attempted Ina Garten's tried-and-true recipe for chive biscuits from scratch, finding the process surprisingly easy.
articles.content: A novice baker's quest for the perfect Thanksgiving biscuits led me to Ina Garten's tried-and-true recipe. With her guidance, I attempted to make chive biscuits from scratch, a task that seemed daunting but ultimately proved surprisingly easy. Garten's recipe is remarkably straightforward and requires minimal ingredients, which made it an attractive choice for a beginner like myself. A batch of eight chive biscuits can be made with just 2 cups of all-purpose flour, half-and-half, cold unsalted butter, baking powder, kosher salt, sugar, egg, and chopped fresh chives or parsley. The recipe's brevity was a welcome respite from more complex baking tasks, and I found the process to be remarkably quick. Preheating the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit set the stage for mixing the dry ingredients first, which included flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar. Garten's chive biscuits are renowned for their buttery, light, and fluffy texture, qualities that seemed like a tall order for a novice baker. With a limited number of ingredients and steps involved, I was eager to see if her recipe would deliver on its promise of ease and quality. As I began preparing the dough, I couldn't help but think about Garten's reputation as the go-to chef for Thanksgiving cooking. Her recipes are often cited as perfect for special occasions, and it seemed like making chive biscuits from scratch using her recipe was a great way to put that claim to the test. I added the dry ingredients - flour, baking powder, salt, and sugar - to the bowl of my electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment. This initial step was straightforward, requiring minimal effort on my part. The dry ingredients were simply poured into the mixing bowl and left to await further processing. With all the dry components in place, I felt a sense of anticipation for what was to come. Next, I added the diced butter to the mixing bowl. As I began to mix on low speed, the butter started to break down and combine with the dry ingredients. The mixture began to resemble coarse crumbs, a sign that the butter was starting to integrate into the dough. With the mixer still on low, I added the half-and-half, watching as it incorporated smoothly into the mixture. The mixture needed only a brief stirring to ensure everything was just combined, according to Garten's instructions. This gentle approach helped maintain the delicate balance of ingredients and prevented over-working the dough. After this initial mixing step, I added the chopped chives, introducing their fresh flavor and aroma into the mix. With the addition of the chives, the mixture still needed some further processing. In line with Garten's advice to beat the mixture until it's just combined, I continued to mix for a short while longer. This brief kneading process helped bring the dough together, creating a cohesive mass that was ready in mere minutes. The ease and speed of this initial mixing and kneading surprised me, given my limited experience with making dough from scratch. Kneading is an essential step in developing the gluten that gives biscuits their structure and softness. I used the heels of my hands to push down on the dough and then push it outward as I kneaded. The process involves folding the dough in half towards myself and pushing it down and out again with the heels of my hands. To ensure the dough didn't become too sticky, I made sure to add flour whenever necessary during the kneading process. This helped me maintain a consistent texture throughout the dough. As I repeated the steps, I tried to knead the dough into a rectangle shape as instructed by Garten. While attempting to achieve a ¾-inch thickness, my kneading was somewhat uneven, resulting in some biscuits being slightly thinner than others. However, keeping the dough on the thicker side is recommended for fluffier biscuits. This is an important consideration when shaping the biscuits before baking. Once I had shaped all the biscuits, I moved on to preparing the egg wash. Mixing one egg with one tablespoon of water created a ready-to-use mixture that helped give the biscuits their golden-brown color. The egg wash was applied evenly to each biscuit before they were placed in the preheated oven. Before throwing the pan into the oven, I made sure to brush each biscuit with the egg wash, which plays a crucial role in achieving the desired color and texture of the biscuits. The biscuits were done to perfection in just 22 minutes, following Ina Garten's recommended baking time. Garten advises that the biscuits are ready when their tops are golden brown and the insides are firm, a clear indicator of their doneness. The chive biscuits turned out beautifully, with a lovely golden hue and a satisfying crunch on top that gave way to a buttery and fluffy interior. The combination of saltiness from the ingredients and the pop of color from the chives made for a delightful flavor experience. articles.title: Observations of Social Interactions Among Wild Assamese Macaques Reveal Benefits for Group Hierarchy Position
articles.summary: Researchers observed 46 male Assamese macaques in Thailand over two years and found that watching friendly interactions can lead to stronger social bonds and higher ranks.
articles.content: Observations of social interactions among wild Assamese macaques have revealed that watching others can be beneficial for an individual's position within the group hierarchy. Researchers from Germany's DPZ and the University of Göttingen conducted a two-year study in Thailand, focusing on 46 male Assamese macaques. The team observed how long these animals spent observing other males interacting with each other during social encounters. The scientists recorded more than 440 instances where a macaque watched two other males engage in interactions, which were categorized as either friendly or aggressive. These observations suggest that the ability to observe and evaluate social interactions may be an essential skill for macaques. By studying how these animals allocate their attention towards others, researchers hope to gain insights into the evolution of social intelligence in primates. Males that spent more time watching friendly interactions within their group developed closer social bonds with specific other males by the end of the first year. These stronger bonds led to higher ranks in the dominance hierarchy for these males by the second year, a significant finding that highlights the importance of social connections in primate societies. The research suggests that observing others is not just about learning new behaviors or gaining knowledge, but also about building relationships and alliances that ultimately contribute to social success. This understanding can be seen as a crucial step in deciphering the evolution of social intelligence in primates. In fact, the data show that males who interfered more frequently in social situations had likely gained valuable information from their observations, which helped them decide when and how to intervene. The researchers found that observing aggressive interactions did not have a direct impact on social bonding or dominance success among males. In fact, the amount of time they spent watching fights had no bearing on their position in the group hierarchy. A different explanation seems to be at play when it comes to managing risk during conflicts. All males appeared to watch closely during fights, as none wanted to get drawn into a dispute against their will. This uniform behavior did not give any individual an advantage over others. The study's findings suggest that observing others is linked to forming closer social bonds. These stronger relationships in turn lead to higher dominance ranks and greater mating success. According to the researchers, this sequence of events implies a causal relationship between observation and bonding. Studies like this one help shed light on how social intelligence has evolved over time. Humans also tend to keep track of who gets along with whom and who is arguing. If observing others provides an advantage in other primates, it could offer clues about why this ability developed in our primate relatives, and potentially even in humans. The researchers propose that observing others may have become a crucial skill for survival in social groups, ultimately contributing to the evolution of advanced social intelligence. Observing others' interactions within a group may have played a crucial role in the evolution of advanced social intelligence among primates. This idea is supported by research showing that male macaques who pay attention to their peers' behavior are more likely to achieve higher ranks and secure mating opportunities. articles.title: Feline Chronic Kidney Disease Diagnosis Breakthrough
articles.summary: Researchers have made significant progress in identifying potential biomarkers that could help diagnose and treat chronic kidney disease (CKD) in cats.
articles.content: A Breakthrough in Diagnosing Feline Chronic Kidney Disease Researchers have made significant progress in identifying potential biomarkers that could help diagnose and treat chronic kidney disease (CKD) in cats. This debilitating condition often goes undiagnosed until its late stages, making it difficult to manage effectively. A recent study published in the Journal of Proteome Research has shed new light on how feline CKD develops, offering veterinarians valuable insights into detecting different stages of the disease. Feline chronic kidney disease is a broad term that encompasses various disorders causing kidney damage and dysfunction. The condition is particularly prevalent among older cats, making it challenging to distinguish between natural aging and disease progression. In some cases, definitive diagnoses may require invasive procedures such as biopsies and extensive laboratory tests, which can be time-consuming and costly. The study's findings are promising for cat owners and veterinarians alike. While blood-based biomarkers do exist, they often fail to pinpoint the root cause of kidney dysfunction or only detect mid-to-late stages of feline CKD. The newly identified protein biomarkers in urine could help fill this diagnostic gap, enabling veterinarians to develop more targeted treatments. The discovery of these potential biomarkers is a significant step towards improving feline health care. Further research will be necessary to validate their effectiveness and explore their potential as diagnostic tools. For now, the study's findings offer hope for cat owners struggling with the challenges of managing this irreversible condition. The search for more precise biomarkers is a pressing issue in the medical community, not just limited to feline chronic kidney disease (CKD). According to lead researcher Katelyn Brusach, this challenge is common across various chronic diseases. To address this problem, Brusach and her team conducted a study using urine as a non-invasive sample to further characterize CKD. The research analyzed urine from 30 healthy cats and 34 cats with CKD, identifying over 2,000 proteins in feline urine. One protein, MMP-7, showed promise as an early-stage biomarker for CKD, with higher levels detected in patients than in healthy controls. However, a single biomarker may not provide a comprehensive understanding of the disease. Chronic diseases are often complex and heterogeneous, making it difficult to encapsulate them with a single protein. Brusach noted that this is why her team sought to utilize urinary protein profiles to measure how different protein groups trend across the disease. The researchers found three distinct subgroups of proteins in the urine samples from cats with late-stage CKD. These subgroups could potentially be used to classify different types of the disease and inform treatment plans, providing a more nuanced understanding of the condition. Researchers have made significant progress in identifying new biomarkers for diagnosing feline chronic kidney disease (CKD). By analyzing a comprehensive list of proteins present in cat urine, they were able to pinpoint distinct patterns that could distinguish between different stages of the disease. These protein profiles may provide a more accurate and nuanced understanding of CKD in cats than traditional markers, which can sometimes miss subtle changes. This breakthrough has the potential to revolutionize the way veterinarians diagnose and treat feline kidney disease, allowing for more targeted treatment plans. The discovery paves the way for further research into the development of clinical biomarkers for feline CKD diagnosis and treatment, ultimately leading to improved health outcomes for cats affected by this condition. articles.content: Martine Rose has been named as Balenciaga's new creative director, marking a historic moment for the French fashion house and cementing her status as a leading figure in menswear. This appointment comes after months of speculation and rumors, which have finally been confirmed with the announcement that Rose will be taking over from Pierpaolo Piccioli, who is leaving Balenciaga after just three seasons at the helm. The British-Jamaican designer has spent nearly two decades building a reputation for her eponymous label, which has gained an outsize influence in the fashion world through its unique visual language and collaborations with streetwear brands. Rose's clothes are characterized by their playful styling, graphic-driven sportswear, offbeat tailoring, and covetable sneaker collaborations, often incorporating unconventional elements such as lace-up fastenings on soccer jerseys or chap-covered suit trousers. Rose's approach to fashion challenges traditional notions of style, often blending sportswear and tailoring in unexpected ways. On her runways, these two seemingly disparate elements frequently share center stage, reflecting her willingness to defy conventions. Her design aesthetic draws inspiration from London's rich subcultural heritage, incorporating influences from rave culture, football fandom, and mod styles. This eclecticism is a hallmark of Rose's approach, with no emphasis on creating outfits that conform to traditional notions of style. Martine Rose's influence extends far beyond the runway. Her designs have been worn by some of the most recognizable figures in entertainment, including Drake, Timothée Chalamet, Bad Bunny, and A$AP Rocky. One notable example of her high-profile styling is Kendrick Lamar's 2025 Super Bowl halftime performance. He wore a custom red, white, and blue leather varsity jacket designed by Rose, an outfit that undoubtedly added to the spectacle of the event. Rose has managed to transcend fashion's tribal boundaries, earning coverage from both mainstream publications like Vogue and online fashion hubs such as Hypebeast. Her appearances at London Fashion Week have become a staple, and she made her Milan debut in 2024. In addition to her runway presence, Rose has collaborated with several prominent brands, including Supreme, for whom she has produced two highly successful collections. She has also worked with Nike to reimagine the Shox and Monarch sneakers, turning them into coveted items among sneaker enthusiasts. Martine Rose's appointment as creative director at Balenciaga marks a significant shift in her career trajectory. She has spent years building an idiosyncratic brand that blends high-end fashion with streetwear sensibilities. Rose's ability to reimagine familiar clothes and make them feel fresh is one of the key reasons she was hired by Kering, the luxury group that owns Balenciaga. Her talent lies in taking existing styles and turning them into something unexpected and desirable. As she takes on this new challenge, Rose will have access to vast resources and a global platform, presenting her with both opportunities and constraints.
